title: Kuch nahin kuch nahin chahiye yeshu

lines.text: Kuch nahin kuch nahin chahiye Yeshu,
Tu mera pita , main tera beta,
Tu chale to phir main chaalu
Tu ruke to main bhi rukoo,
Tu kahe vo hi main sunoo

chords:
[Chorus]
Kuch nahin kuch nahin chahiye Yeshu,
Bas tu hi tu chahiye
...repeat

[Verse 2]
Tu mera pita , main tera beta,
Ye rishta kaafi hai mujhe
...repeat

[Verse 3]
Tu chale to phir main chaalu
Tu ruke to main bhi rukoo,
Tu kahe vo hi main sunoo
Dikhae jo mujhe dekhoo
...repeat
